_about: 0.2.1 hotfix (2 Nov 2026): the player row hud_prompts (0 always shown, 1 shown on a change or an action, the default), after hud_context. Apply with specpatch.py to part2_data.js and docs/UI_SPEC.json (and the artifact's ui/spec, pinned set, after reading). Registry: controller/src/impl/controller.cpp hud_prompts; rule: core/game/promptshow.h.

rows.label: Show context prompts
rows.help: When the context prompts show in flight. On change: they appear when they change or right after you act (dock, cruise, a target, a maneuver), stay four seconds, then fade out. Always: they stay on screen.
